text:
sloane: Quick ask — can someone run a short preflight pairwise perf comparison H100 vs L40S for the 13B family? Need p50/p95/p99 + throughput for seq=2048 and batch sizes [1,2,4,8]. KV-cache warm + cold. No need for exhaustive runs, just enough to catch obvious regressions. Ideally include thermal/driver telemetry if possible.

aj: I can take this. Do we want fp16 only or include int8/LLM.int8?

sloane: start with fp16 baseline. If time permits, add int8 (per-model quant profile) — but primary is fp16 p99. Also tag the run with `preflight/13B/seq2048` so we can filter.

maria: infra note — we have H100 nodes with current driver 535.86 and L40S with 535.54. If we see p99 spikes on H100 might be driver-related. I'll ensure nodes are dedicated for the run.

lucas: FYI there's a recent kernel fallback on H100 causing microbursts in tiny-batch workloads (reported last week). If you see weird p99s, please include `dmesg`/driver logs.

aj: SG, I'll use the `perf-bench` job image (redwood/perf-bench:2026-03-01). Command I'll run (rough sketch):

```bash
perf-bench run \
  --model redwood/instruct-v2-13B \
  --seq-len 2048 \
  --batches 1,2,4,8 \
  --kv-cache warm,cold \
  --precision fp16 \
  --warmup 50 \
  --tokens 20000 \
  --tag preflight/13B/seq2048
```

kai: please capture `nvtop`/DCGM snapshots every 10s and a 1Hz kernel scheduler trace if possible. Those helped for the last regression. Also export CSV of p50/p95/p99 and mean throughput.

aj: will capture DCGM and sysmetrics. Do we want to run on both H100 flavor SKUs we have (h100-80gb, h100-80gb-v2) or pick one?

sloane: pick the most common one in prod (h100-80gb). If time, run the v2 variant later. Main priority: H100 vs L40S parity.

maria: I've reserved h100-80gb-01 and l40s-03 for the next 2 hrs. Bench job queued, run id: preflight-2381234567-rc1.

bench-bot: Scheduled run `preflight-2381234567-rc1` on h100-80gb-01 and l40s-03. ETA ~40m, logs at https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/preflight-2381234567-rc1 (internal).

aj: kicked off. Small note: using the latest runtime image may switch to the new attention kernel selection. I'll pin `--runtime-tag=canary-2026-02-28` to reproduce stable behavior.

lucas: if the H100 p99 >> L40S, include a short stacktrace snippet from the runtime (token loop + kernel fallback) — that'll make triage faster.

(40m later)

bench-bot: Run finished. Summary: H100 p50=10ms p95=24ms p99=34ms throughput@batch1=180 tps. L40S p50=12ms p95=26ms p99=42ms throughput@batch1=160 tps. Full CSV + DCGM logs uploaded. https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/preflight-2381234567-rc1/results.csv

aj: quick observations — H100 has slightly better p50/p95 but p99 delta is ~8ms. No dmesg driver errors. DCGM shows occasional SM util dips aligning with p99 on H100 (attached).

kai: can you share the CSV? I'll generate p99 breakdown per-layer. Also check memory clocks on the H100 during p99 spikes (thermal throttling possible).

aj: CSV here (internal link). Memory clocks steady ~1950MHz, temperature peaked at 78C, no throttle.

sloane: thanks — can you open a short PR to add these results to the preflight dashboard and add a note: `h100 p99 outlier ~8ms vs l40s; need kernel trace if reoccurs`. Assign to @eng-runtime for follow-up.

maria: added the run to the dashboard and created a short issue: INF-2381 — linking logs.

lucas: I can do a follow-up kernel trace next run; maybe test with `--runtime-tag=stable-2026-02-14` to compare.

aj: ack, will re-run canary vs stable tomorrow and post diffs.

kai: thanks all. If the follow-up shows kernel fallback correlation, we should roll back the canary on H100 or apply the kernel fix.

sloane: perfect. Thanks @aj @maria for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

aj: np.

maria: :thumbsup:

lucas: :eyes:
